output.narrative:
Revenue increased by 252.7 (22.11%), driven primarily by requests (contribution 220.17) and ecpm (contribution 36.81). The ecpm metric rose by 2.95%.

This increase was disproportionately driven by two independent primary segments: ad_format=video (explanatory power 1.352, lift 10.37) and category=finance (explanatory power 0.744, lift 10.32). Other dimensions like vertical=auto were checked and ruled out with a low lift of 0.99.

Within ad_format=video, the ecpm increase is further concentrated in category=finance (explanatory power 0.714, lift 9.76) and country=US (explanatory power 0.819, lift 4.06). Within category=finance, it is further concentrated in ad_format=video (explanatory power 0.372, lift 2.81). Moving deeper into video and US requests, category=finance remains primary (explanatory power 0.78, lift 10.17).
